nodes.title: Floor exemptions tuned on the DEV look-alike set as the route to a floor-or-judge benign FP of at most 2/100: on blind look-alikes the floor still flags 6/100
nodes.tried: 2bd4daf: clause-scoped crisis-floor exemptions tuned on sets/dev-lookalike-9.json. The Tamil laughter word, someone else's past suicide, a third person or film character jumping, and a Bengali spelling variant took DEV look-alike FP from 3/150 to 0/150, with recall kept.
nodes.broke: BLIND 9 (100 unread look-alikes, separate writer): floor alone FP 6/100 (2.8-12.5), in te-en 2/17 and bn-en, gu-en, hinglish and mr-en 1 each. The judge added 2 false alarms on other lines, so floor or judge was 8/100 against the owner's 2/100 bar, while the judge alone was 2/100. The system is raise-only, so no judge threshold or prompt can take the combined FP below the floor's. DEV look-alikes were easier for the floor (0/150) than blind ones; tuning on them did not carry. A next step must be measured on a fresh blind set: floor FP down to about 0-2/100 on look-alikes, or a floor-only crisis on a look-alike also taking the gentle check-in path (an owner/product question).
